author.name: Academy of Cognitive and Natural Sciences

description: Official LaTeX template for paper submissions to the ICon-MaSTEd, ICSF, and other ANCS conferences, based on the IOP Journal of Physics: Conference Series (jpconf) class. Provides a single-column A4 layout with numbered superscript author/affiliation blocks, an abstract environment, sequential or section-based equation/figure/table numbering, custom cross-reference commands, an appendix mechanism, and numeric bracketed citations via iopart-num-long, based on the jpconf document class extended with the iopams package for bold Greek letters and extra AMS symbols.
